title: Sphere leaves in eight seconds

tellings.quote: But when that thing took off, within 8 seconds of the time I spotted the sweepand till the time the thing was a pinpoint of light in a night sky, 8 seconds had elapsed.

plain: Charlie Foltz, one of a group of campers at Eagle Lake on the Allagash Waterway in Maine in 1976, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that they saw a glowing sphere over the water. He says that when it took off, only eight seconds passed from the moment he noticed it moving until it was a pinpoint of light in the night sky, a speed far beyond any ordinary aircraft.
